description: Moves messages to another folder, e.g. "archive", "trash", "spam", "inbox" or a named folder. Deleting means moving to Trash; this extension never permanently deletes anything.

account.description: Which mailbox to use, by its name or email address. Configured: none configured yet. Required when more than one is set up.

destination.description: Where to move them: "archive", "trash", "spam", "inbox" or an exact folder name.

folder.description: Folder the messages are in now. Defaults to the inbox.

ids.description: Message ids from search or inbox results, all from the same folder.

name: move_emails
title: Move emails
